title: beam_coherence records (analysis/coherence.jsonl)
description: One record per closed epoch-aligned interval (default 60 s) from the analyzer's `coherence` plugin (analysis/coherence.py): how phase-coherent the 8 beam outputs are with each other, per ring-adjacent beam pair and octave band, conditioned on quiet / active windows. Windows in which a beam is muted (DSP gating) or the audio is lost are counted but excluded. MSC values are RAW (biased upward by about `msc_floor` for independent noise). Metadata only; no audio is ever stored. Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields and skip a record whose `v` they do not know.

cell.description: Statistics of one (band, condition) over the windows of the interval; index = ring-adjacent pair p = (beam p, beam (p+1)%8), beams counted from 0. `ph_deg` is the circular mean over windows of the cross-phase at the band's centre bin (`centre_hz`), positive = beam p+1 lags beam p; `ph_spread_deg` its circular standard deviation sqrt(-2 ln R). `lag_*` in samples at 48 kHz (positive = beam p+1 lags beam p), `lag_spread` = p90 - p10. `dl_db_p50` = band level of beam p minus beam p+1. `msc_unmasked_p50` is present only for bands that contain tonal-mask bins and is the median with those bins included.

band.description: One octave band. `n_quiet` / `n_active` windows were stored for the condition (a cell with fewer than 5 windows is null), `mid` windows lay between the quiet and active margins, `warmup` windows came before the noise floor was known. n_quiet + n_active + mid + warmup = win_used.

full_cond.description: Median MSC of all 28 beam pairs (i < j, row-major: 0-1, 0-2, ... 0-7, 1-2, ... 6-7) in each of the 3 broad bands; `n` = windows per band; a null msc entry means fewer than 3 windows in that band.

t.description: End of the interval, Unix seconds (t0 + span_s).

t0.description: Start of the epoch-aligned interval: a multiple of span_s.

partial.description: Optional, present only when true: the interval is incomplete (flushed at analyzer shutdown, or the analyzer started late in it); span_s is still the nominal length, win_total says how many windows it holds.

level_dbfs.description: Mean over the used windows of the window's mean-square level over the beams, dB re full scale; null without a used window.

msc_floor.description: 1 / K_eff: the mean raw MSC of independent signals (about 0.048). The raw mean is c + (1 - c)^2 / K_eff for a true MSC c, K_eff = 1 / msc_floor; invert it (spec: Bias).

xc_lag.description: Per pair: median over the used windows of the broadband (125-4000 Hz) cross-correlation lag in samples (largest-magnitude peak, parabolic interpolation on its magnitude; polarity is not reported, see ph_deg); null with fewer than 5 used windows.
